user.title: New TTS fallback chain
user.description: The chain provides its own TTS entity. It asks the TTS services one after another and uses the first one that works. You define the stages in the next step.

data.name: Name
data.quota_cooldown: Pause after a quota / rate limit error (429)

data_description.name: Also used for the entity ID, e.g. tts.tts_fallback_kette.
data_description.language: Language used when the caller does not specify one.
data_description.timeout: If a stage does not answer within this time, the next stage is used.
data_description.error_cooldown: How long a stage is skipped after a regular error. 0 = never skip.
data_description.quota_cooldown: How long a stage is skipped when its quota is used up (e.g. Gemini free tier). 0 = never skip.

data_description.voice: E.g. Callirrhoe for Google Gemini or Katja for Home Assistant Cloud. You can also type a voice ID.
data_description.language: Only set this if this stage should always use a specific language.
data_description.extra_options: Additional TTS options of the service, e.g. `audio_output: mp3`.
